shortDescription: India’s Shapoorji Pallonji Group is in talks with lenders to one of its units to extend a bond payment due at the end of September, according to Bloomberg. The conglomerate is behind the country’s biggest private credit deal.

title: Shapoorji Pallonji Seeks Delay on September Bond Payment
